entities.name: S3 (2)

entities.rationale: Green square Amazon FSx icon pointing to SageMaker.

entities.name: IAM

visual_connections.description: User connects directly to main EKS cluster.
EKS cluster connects to Amazon SageMaker.
SageMaker outputs data to Amazon S3 bucket.
Amazon S3 connects back to EKS with text label HDS written over the arrow.
Hospital actor icon points directly to S3(2).
Secondary bucket S3(2) points directly to EKS.
Amazon FSx green icon points directly to SageMaker.
